Status: COMPLETE — reviewed 2026-07-16, grade B-: engine core landed; 4 slices honest-blocked on same-round dispatch

Opened at Strategize, 2026-07-16. Fifteen surveyors are mapping the engine's ground; the Digest section will follow their reports, then the verify plan, then decisions D33+, then the debrief.

The wish (user-approved wave)

W3 of the Scaffy epic: the ENGINE. bp scaffy run and bp scaffy remove in Go on top of the merged internal/scaffy parser/validator (W2, live) and the D20–D32 grammar law: apply commands with variable substitution (spelling-as-transform casings incl. the D22 OPAQUE/SHAPE/SUCCESSOR annotations), byte-exact fenced-bytes REPLACE matcher (D20), MARK planting + REANCHOR run≥2 semantics (D21 — first run anchors structurally, later runs re-anchor at the mark family tail), payload-verbatim bytes / empty fence = 0-byte file / CREATE implies mkdir -p (D26), guards (ASLONG FILE [DONT] CONTAIN + payload-derived mark guards) making re-runs no-ops, DIRECTION-aware remove that retracts marked spans and deletes owned files, apply RECEIPTS persisted (.scaffy/receipts/) so remove replays the receipt, dry-run diff mode, and ASSERT execution honoring LOCAL vs TIER ci (ci-tier asserts reported as deferred, never run locally; CC=/usr/bin/clang for any Go gate the engine shells). The showcase paper's run/re-run transcripts are the SOFT OUTPUT SPEC — meet them or formally amend the paper. North star: run add-block-type against the real tree in a worktree, gates green, remove, tree byte-clean; AND prove the REANCHOR fix live — add-oban-worker applied twice (two workers) yields a parsing config.exs, then remove both cleanly. The 6-agent hand-apply reports are prior art. Orchestration lesson from W2, encoded: never dispatch a slice in the same round as its unmerged dependencies.

Where the epic stands

  • W1 (grade A-): 7-command corpus in scaffy/commands/, README front door, showcase paper live at /papers/scaffy-command-showcase.
  • W2 (grade A-, now FULLY merged): grammar law D20–D32 in README + corpus (#3657), greenfield internal/scaffy lexer/AST/28-rule validator/fmt (#3658), bp scaffy validate|fmt CLI wiring (#3663), corpus conformance tripwires (#3664). All 7 corpus files validate to zero findings and are fmt fixpoints. The two W2 slices that stalled on same-round dependency dispatch were re-dispatched and landed.
  • Open ledger: scaffy-backlog-w3-engine (this wave), scaffy-backlog-repo-aware-validate (W3-adjacent: anchor-existence checks belong naturally to the engine's matcher), scaffy-backlog-js-assert-sweep, scaffy-backlog-stale-worktree-drift, plus the standing backlog (api-route-parity, add-schema-type, anchors-omx-exclusion, elixir-local-gate-proof).

Direction (Strategize — tentative until Decide)

W3 makes Scaffy real metal. Everything so far is text and law; nothing executes. The finished experience: in a worktree, bp scaffy run scaffy/commands/add-block-type.scaffy --var BlockName=timeline walks the ops in order — CREATE (mkdir -p, verbatim payload bytes, empty fence ⇒ 0-byte file), INSERT/REPLACE via the byte-exact fenced-bytes matcher with the exactly-once-at-apply-time law, MARK planting, token substitution through the shared word-list joiners honoring OPAQUE (never re-cased), SHAPE ts14 (validated), SUCCESSOR (derived +1) — then runs every ASSERT FILE check and every LOCAL ASSERT CMD (CC=/usr/bin/clang threaded into Go gates), reporting TIER ci asserts as deferred to CI, never executing them locally. Each apply persists a receipt under .scaffy/receipts/. Re-running the same command with the same vars is a guard-driven no-op line-for-line matching the showcase transcript; re-running a REANCHOR command with NEW vars accretes at the tail of the planted mark family (D21 run≥2). bp scaffy remove replays the receipt: retracts marked spans, deletes owned files, tree byte-clean; DIRECTION "remove" commands (remove-docs-card) run first-class through the same engine. --dry-run prints the full diff and touches nothing.

Tentative leanings (Decide finalizes after two explore rounds):

  • Engine code lives inside internal/scaffy (apply.go / subst.go / receipt.go / remove.go or similar), same package as the parser — surveyors check for import-cycle or size reasons to split.
  • Substitution is hand-rolled literal token replacement over the four joiner spellings — never text/template (payload bytes are verbatim by D26; template semantics would be a lie).
  • Receipt = JSON: command id, DIRECTION, resolved vars, per-op record (created files, target file + planted mark family + planted byte spans), enough for remove to work; but REANCHOR run-2 anchoring must be derivable from the TREE alone (mark family tail), never require receipt continuity — receipts serve remove, marks serve re-anchor.
  • The one genuinely unpinned semantic is the D21 mark-family EXTENT rule for multi-line marked blocks (add-cli-verb's 18-line map): how run-2 finds where the last planted block ENDS when the prior run's var values are unknown. Pinning this is a named Decide deliverable.
  • Dry-run diff rendered dep-free (house TUI doctrine); output voice matches bp scaffy validate's findings style and the showcase transcripts.
  • North-star live proof runs in a fresh worktree (D32: primary checkout is foreign-branch and litter-saturated), gates via the corpus's own LOCAL asserts.
  • Orchestration law, encoded from W2's lesson: build rounds are SEQUENCED — engine core merges before CLI wiring / live-proof slices dispatch; no slice ever ships in the same round as its unmerged dependency, or it is made self-contained.

Quality bar (Kinsta/Vercel): the promise of "commands as content" is untested until the flagship survives run → gates green → remove → byte-clean, live. Transcript fidelity to the showcase paper is part of done — meet it or formally amend the paper (wave-1 review handoff).

Survey digest (Digest phase, 2026-07-16)

Thirteen reports in, all coverage-accounted. The wave's premise holds: W3 is fully greenfield engine work over a parser that is already engine-shaped.

Established (file:line-anchored)

  • AST is ready as-is. Closed 3-member Op union, Fenced.Bytes() discharges D26 (empty fence → nil), InOp.Payload nil iff Verb==Remove, Reanchor legality parse-enforced (P-005). The pre-apply gate is ValidateFile == zero findings, never "Parse succeeded" (Parse returns best-effort partial ASTs).
  • Same-package engine is the cheap path. tokenRe, the four joiners (words.go), and payloadBytes are all unexported — apply/subst/receipt/remove files inside internal/scaffy get them for free; a separate package would force an API-surface export decision.
  • D30 census reproduced exactly (11/5/1/5/1/1/12[2v]/30/15[6ci]). SNIPPET/USE is unresolved at parse time — real engine work despite zero corpus instances; synthetic fixture testdata/green/add-widget.scaffy bundles SNIPPET/USE + REANCHOR + MARK VIRTUAL + OPAQUE/SHAPE/SUCCESSOR + EXISTS + TIER ci in one file.
  • D21 extent has a concrete candidate rule: the payload template's line count is invariant across runs (only leaf tokens substitute), so extent K = mark-line through payload end is precomputable from the UNSUBSTITUTED AST — no prior-run vars, no runtime brace-counting, no receipt continuity needed for re-anchoring. Unproven live; the verify fleet proves or kills it.
  • Showcase paper is STALE and incomplete as a soft spec: its oban/cli-verb source blocks predate REANCHOR (zero REANCHOR hits file-wide); NO transcript exists for run-2-new-vars accretion or for --dry-run. The paper MUST be formally amended this wave — there is no transcript to "meet" for the north-star REANCHOR proof.
  • CLI wiring is a template drop-in: scaffy noun already registered (builtins.go:320), completion-nouns test never descends into the verb switch, --dry-run is a pre-parsed global (globals.go:26), --var must be hand-rolled (no shared K=V parser exists), exit codes stay 0/2/4/5, TestScaffyPureLocal only scans scaffy_cmd.go (new-file placement silently drops that guard).
  • Guard mechanics are already law, not engine choice: guard base branches on (Verb==Remove || !Dont) → target else payload; add=DONT CONTAIN / remove=CONTAIN is lint-enforced; non-self-consuming INSERTs use the implicit planted-MARK check while add-docs-card also carries an explicit ASLONG — engine must honor both paths. Guard evaluation precedes anchor resolution; per-op skip never aborts siblings.
  • Anchors: zero drift. Every D11/D13 anchor byte-verified against HEAD 543d9a7f5 today; no scaffy markers exist anywhere in target files; count is still exactly 42.
  • Exec reality: 2/9 LOCAL and 6/6 ci ASSERT CMDs are cd X && … shell one-liners — only sh -c execution works; CC=/usr/bin/clang has a live Env-injection precedent (cli_test.go:1273); TIER ci = literal "ci" string, trivially gated. Timeout, output capture, and cwd policy are UNWRITTEN.
  • Receipts are non-optional: 5 of 6 add-direction commands have no authored remove counterpart, yet the north star demands removing exactly those — receipt replay is the only mechanism that can satisfy the epic's own acceptance bar. Location precedent converges on repo-root/cwd (.scaffy/receipts/), gitignored by explicit name. Keying must be per command+vars (two oban receipts must coexist and retract independently) with resolved mark names recorded per op.
  • Dry-run prior art: hand-rolled LCS diffLines already exists (cmux_install_merge.go:322, unexported in package cli); diff libs in go.sum are transitive-only; house doctrine is dep-free. Two voices in tension: showcase per-op status lines vs -/+ line diff.
  • Worktree harness: fresh worktree is mandatory (698 litter worktrees now; unscoped pdrender suite hangs; docs-anchors-check 24s fresh vs >115s in-place); elixir -e 'Code.string_to_quoted!' (~3s) is the proven LOCAL parse check for config.exs, sidestepping elixir-build-borrow entirely.
  • Ledger scope: scaffy-backlog-w3-engine IS the wave (its brief pre-declares 3 residue items out of scope); repo-aware-validate is a legitimate dependent fast-follow (shares the byte-exact matcher primitive) sequenced AFTER the matcher merges; js-assert-sweep stays parked; the 3 stale worktrees (19c-25/26/28) are confirmed still present, clean, non-ancestors — prune as a zero-dependency pre-flight.

Contradictions the survey surfaced

  • SUCCESSOR: charter D22 says "the +1 crosses as a declared pair, checked, never computed"; this wave paper's own Direction text says "derived +1". Direct contradiction — Decide must pin (law should win: engine validates a user-supplied pair, never computes silently). Materially changes the --var contract.
  • Wish misattribution: "add-cli-verb sibling accretion (Foo→Bar→Baz forward)" was actually PROVEN on add-oban-worker only; cli-verb's multi-line (18-line map) accretion has never been mechanically exercised — it is exactly the unpinned D21 extent case.
  • Strategy's "REANCHOR derivable from tree alone" holds for anchoring but NOT necessarily for remove-extent: REPLACE reversal needs pre-image bytes not recoverable from the post-apply tree in general — thin-vs-fat receipt schema hangs on this and on the D21 ruling.
  • Showcase remove transcript (bp scaffy remove docs-card --var …) is ambiguous between authored-remove-command dispatch and receipt replay; it predates the receipt concept entirely.
  • D32's "primary checkout sits on a foreign branch" is volatile — currently false (main, clean, 0/0) — scripts must check live, never assume.

Coverage map — checked and NOT found (absences are decisions-in-waiting)

Found and settled: full AST/parse/lint/words surface; all 7 corpus files op-by-op; charter D1–D32; W1/W2 wave papers; showcase JSON in full; CLI dispatch + test guards; deploy-state/gitignore precedent; diff prior art; gate timings (partly stale); all north-star anchors; the 4 backlog tasks; both hand-apply evidence tasks.

Checked and NOT found (the absences that shape Decide): zero apply/receipt/remove code anywhere; no run/remove CLI verbs, no --var parser, no repo-root helper (everything cwd-anchored); no REANCHOR-run-2 or dry-run transcript in the showcase; no exec-mechanism/timeout/output policy in any doc; no receipt schema prior art; no standalone hand-apply report artifacts (distilled into 2 tasks + W2 paper only); words helpers unexported.

Corners no surveyor reached: format.go line-by-line (doc.go's "Format never rewrites payload bytes" taken on faith); red/*.scaffy fixtures P-005/E-016/E-008 not deeply read; only 3 of 21+ worktrees re-audited for drift; org-wide search query prior-art sweep never successfully executed (verb confusion recurred across 5+ surveyors); fresh-worktree build timings are stale (W1's 6.7s vs 48s measured in the littered checkout).

What Decide cannot live without

  1. The D21 extent rule, PROVEN live (static-K vs brace-balance) on the 18-line cli-verb map — blocks apply.go.
  2. Receipt schema (thin vs fat; which REPLACEs need stored pre-image bytes), keying, gitignore, drift-refusal policy.
  3. bp scaffy remove dispatch semantics (authored-remove lookup vs receipt replay vs both) + the showcase amendment plan.
  4. SUCCESSOR/SHAPE/OPAQUE runtime contract for --var values.
  5. ASSERT CMD exec mechanism (sh -c + Env CC=clang), timeout default, cwd rule, dry-run's treatment of LOCAL asserts.
  6. Transcript/dry-run output voice (per-op status lines; where a -/+ diff appears; CMD grouping; #-comment echo stripping).
  7. File placement (run/remove inside scaffy_cmd.go or widen TestScaffyPureLocal) and whether repo-aware-validate rides as a trailing slice.

Verification results (Verify → Decide, 2026-07-16)

Six verifiers, every load-bearing claim proven with run output. Coverage including not-founds is in each report; the decisive lines:

  • extent-static-k-live-proof — STATIC-K PROVEN. Mechanical splice with K from the unsubstituted template (cli-verb K=19, oban K=2), no brace balancing: "run 1/2/3: parses=True … retract 3/2/1: parses=True … git diff --stat (empty) exit=0" on the REAL cli.ex and config.exs. The mark-scoped finder ignored the pre-existing TagDistribution tuple (config.exs:232). Two caveats now law: a K-only remove leaves a stray comma that PARSES ("naive-remove parses: True") — byte-clean is the only honest gate (D34); K-invariance requires single-line --var values (D33a).
  • assert-cmd-exec-proof — sh -c MANDATORY, 900s floor. All 9 LOCAL CMDs ran green via sh -c + Env-appended CC=/usr/bin/clang; argv-split exec fails outright ("no such file or directory: CC=/usr/bin/clang go build …"). Cold pnpm bootstrap measured real 740.64s (turbo 0/11 cached) — any timeout under ~900s kills the flagship. docs-anchors-check: 153.66s with node_modules vs 70.33s clean (the 24s figure not reproducible here; the script only post-filters node_modules — backlogged). add-widget's go build target does not exist pre-apply — asserts run AFTER ops.
  • successor-shape-opaque-runtime — LINTS ARE SOURCE-TEXT ONLY. Fresh probes fired E-014 (EXAMPLES "50" is not CountBefore's EXAMPLES ("42") + 1), E-015 ×2, E-013 ×2; the corpus baseline stays {files:7, findings:[], ok:true}. No runtime --var validation exists anywhere — the engine adds it (D37). The charter's "declared pair, checked, never computed" WINS over this paper's earlier Direction wording "SUCCESSOR (derived +1)", which is hereby corrected.
  • snippet-use-conformance — add-widget.scaffy is parse/lint-wired (TestParseGreenFullGrammar asserts Payload.Use=="widget-div" and empty fence == 0 bytes) but NO byte-resolution code exists; the engine slice writes its own apply tests — the fixture inherits zero protection from corpus_test.go. All 7 corpus files still validate zero-findings at HEAD; the installed bp binary was stale (rebuild before verifying).
  • cli-stub-wiring-proof — run/remove verb stubs + hand-rolled --var + an os/exec import red NOTHING; the full internal/cli suite stays green. The one failure found: TestScaffyPureLocal is a raw substring scan — a COMMENT naming the banned helpers reds it. Trap encoded in D40 and the cli-wiring brief.
  • receipt-preimage-audit — REANCHOR run≥2 REPLACE pre-images belong to a SIBLING run (never derivable from the removing run's own vars): fat receipts are mandatory on the hard case → uniform fat schema (D35). Remove-dispatch reconciled (D36): remove = receipt replay; DIRECTION-remove commands are run targets. LIFO-within-family falls out of drift-refusal. No .gitignore entry existed for .scaffy/.
  • bp-search-prior-art-once — full scaffy sweep (5 papers, 24 tasks): no orphaned engine prior art. Verb truth recorded: bp task get (not "show"); bp search query "…" -o json [--all]. Confirmed the wish's misattribution: Foo→Bar→Baz ran on add-oban-worker; cli-verb's 18-line map is first exercised THIS wave. Dry-run prior art: the hand-rolled LCS diffLines (cmux_install_merge.go:325), dep-free.

Decisions (Decide, 2026-07-16) — D33–D43, charter-committed (416712bdb)

Full text lives in the charter (the epic's memory); one line each here:

  • D33 — REANCHOR extent = static-K-from-template (proven byte-clean live); --var values must be single-line; the separator comma is edited in-place, byte-adjacent to the prior brace.
  • D34 — byte-clean (git diff --stat empty) is THE remove gate; parse-only gates are vacuous (Elixir tolerates trailing commas).
  • D35 — receipts are uniform FAT (post-image always, pre-image for REPLACE-family), keyed per command+vars under repo-root .scaffy/receipts/, gitignored by explicit name.
  • D36 — bp scaffy remove = receipt replay; DIRECTION-remove commands run forward via run; 3-outcome drift-refusal (invert / idempotent skip / SCAFFY-DRIFT fail-loud); LIFO within a mark family.
  • D37 — runtime --var contract: SUCCESSOR is a supplied pair CHECKED never computed (the law wins); ts14 re-validated at run time; OPAQUE verbatim; the pre-apply gate is ValidateFile == zero findings.
  • D38 — ASSERT CMD = sh -c verbatim from repo root, CC=/usr/bin/clang env-appended, 900s default timeout, TIER ci deferred never executed, asserts after ops.
  • D39 — output voice: showcase per-op vocabulary, ONE line per ASSERT CMD (per-surface grouping dropped, paper amended), structured envelope, exit 0/2/4/5; --dry-run executes nothing (not even LOCAL asserts) and prints -/+ line diffs.
  • D40 — engine inside internal/scaffy; seam scaffy.Run/Remove(Options) (*RunReport, error); CLI verbs stay in scaffy_cmd.go; the pure-local-guard comment trap encoded.
  • D41 — the showcase paper is FORMALLY AMENDED this wave with real transcripts (run-2 accretion, receipt-replay removes, dry-run, dispatch note, supersedes note).
  • D42 — harness realities: fresh worktree, docs-anchors before js bootstrap, 740s cold pnpm, the foreign-branch claim is volatile; bp verb truths recorded.
  • D43 — sequencing law, permanent: no slice dispatches in the same round as its unmerged dependency; enforced by files-label overlap + AFTER-X-merges brief lines.

Debrief (Review, 2026-07-16) — the wave closes

What shipped

  • scaffy-w3-engine-core — final branch loop-epic/scaffy-w3-engine-core-subst-apply-receip-0-r (review branch; the lead merges THIS one and closes the task's merge-gated criterion 5). The complete D33–D43 forward path: scaffy.Run(RunOptions) (*RunReport, error) per the D40 seam — subst.go (D37 --var contract: missing/unknown/newline rejected, OPAQUE verbatim, SHAPE ts14 re-validated live, SUCCESSOR checked never computed, four-joiner spelling transforms), apply.go (overlay tree: guards before anchors, per-op skip never aborts siblings, op failure writes NOTHING; D26 CREATE with mkdir -p and empty-fence 0-byte file; D20 byte-exact exactly-once REPLACE; D21/D33 static-K REANCHOR with in-place separator comma and tail-shape desync refusal; D38 assert exec sh -c verbatim from RepoRoot, CC=/usr/bin/clang appended, 900s default, TIER ci deferred never executed; D39 dry-run with dep-free LCS diffs), receipt.go (D35 uniform fat receipts keyed per command+vars, no-op re-run never clobbers). 27 tests against the add-widget conformance fixture in t.TempDir(), including a real executed go-build LOCAL assert and TIER-ci side-effect-absence proof. .gitignore gains the banner-commented .scaffy/ entry. Gate green on the final branch (build + vet + test -count=1).

Review verdict on the shipped slice

Adversarial review found zero code defects. Three extra probes were run beyond the suite: a CRLF-line-ending target refuses loudly (D20 zero-count, nothing written); a mid-run op failure leaks NOTHING to disk (the overlay abort — review added a permanent test pinning this, the one review commit); a path-hostile --var value cannot escape the receipts directory. gofmt clean, single tidy commit, no bloat. The builder's own doubt-list was chased: the runtime ASLONG guard base (target-file overlay bytes per README/D23) is the right reading — guardSkip in apply.go is the single seam if the lead ever wants it changed; REMOVE-verb receipts record pre-image without position (fine under D36 — DIRECTION-remove commands run forward, their receipts are not inversion targets — the remove-replay builder should confirm and document); receipts persist BEFORE asserts run (intentional: mutations are real and must be replayable; the CLI slice should surface that state).

What stalled, and why

Four of five slices — scaffy-w3-remove-replay, scaffy-w3-cli-wiring, scaffy-backlog-w3-engine (north-star live proof + D41 showcase amendment), scaffy-backlog-repo-aware-validate — were dispatched in the SAME round as their unmerged dependencies, violating D43 in the very wave that ratified it. The wish itself carried this exact lesson from W2. The saving grace: every blocked builder obeyed its brief's stop-guard — no forked matchers, no blind schema guesses, no collisions, honest BLOCKED notes on the ledger. Zero damage, four burned dispatches.

Grade: B-

What landed is genuinely excellent — the hardest slice of the wave (substitution semantics, the REANCHOR splice, the fat-receipt schema, the assert executor) shipped correct, protectively tested, and honest about its own edges; review changed nothing but added one test. But the wave is graded against the WISH, and the wish asked for the ENGINE: run and remove, CLI verbs, the flagship live proof, the REANCHOR ×2 live demonstration, the showcase amendment. None of that merges this wave — 1 of 5 slices landed, and the north star is untouched. The failure is orchestration, not construction: the same-round dispatch defect recurred despite being named in the wish, encoded as D43, and written into every brief. A charter law that the dispatcher does not read is not yet a law.

Ledger audit

engine-core: claimed, criteria 0–4 stamped with real evidence as work progressed, lifecycle honestly in_progress with criterion 5 (PR merged) left for the lead — exemplary. remove-replay: never claimed, honestly open. cli-wiring and backlog-w3-engine: honest BLOCKED now-lines but left in_progress under dead claims — review released both claims (they now sit open, briefs intact). repo-aware-validate: claim already self-released, open. No foreign tasks touched; no ledger lies found.

Next wave (W3 completion)

  1. Merge loop-epic/scaffy-w3-engine-core-subst-apply-receip-0-r; lead closes engine-core's criterion 5 and the task.
  2. Re-dispatch in TRUE sequence — one round each, dep merged first: remove-replay → cli-wiring → (live proof ∥ repo-aware-validate). All four briefs are ready-to-apply as filed; the engine seam they were promised now exists.
  3. The live-proof slice still owes the D41 showcase amendment and the north-star byte-clean cycle; the REANCHOR ×2 oban demonstration is unit-proven (TestReanchorStaticK) but must be shown LIVE.
  4. Orchestration fix for the runner itself: the dispatcher must consume the dispatch-round structure (D43), not just print it in briefs — until then, launch sequenced waves as separate build rounds manually.
